headline: Last session: Sensex surpasses 81,000 and Nifty settles above 25,000 as market closes for Diwali-Balipratipada

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Indian stock exchanges NSE and BSE are closed today on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
In the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to close at their highest levels in over eight months.
Sensex closed 107 points higher, surpassing the 81,000 mark in the previous session.
Nifty settled above the 25,000 level during the last session.
whatHappening: Blackstone is set to become a key investor in IIFL Finance with a 15% stake.
Data Patterns shares jumped 9% in the last trading session.
Indian stock markets remain closed on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, with trading resuming on Wednesday.
Asian markets rallied while crude oil prices dropped as Indian markets took a holiday.
summary: Indian stock exchanges (NSE and BSE) are closed today, November 10, 2026, for Diwali-Balipratipada. In the last trading session, the Sensex surpassed 81,000 and Nifty settled above 25,000 to hit eight-month highs. Normal trading will resume on Wednesday, November 11.
